findings.title: CI autopilot job is red because the helper provenance map vouches for CHANGELOG bytes that never existed at the tested revision, and --check cannot see it
Nineteen owner and capacity controller tests landed without the feature, so CI fails with missing_capability
A corrupt or drifted .claude-plugin/plugin.json passes the validator and the marketplace check
Deeply nested JSON input crashes the autopilot facade with a traceback and exit 1 instead of a usage error
Controller snapshot reports absent and ok for a store missing state.json while apply on the same root says recovery_required
A new plugin copied from the template is silently left out of the Claude Code catalog
--diagnose reports Claude as unauthenticated for a logged-in Claude Code user
Shipped facade commands --probe-host, --run-guard and --diagnose are missing from the README and CHANGELOG
The changelog's public controller CLI has no docs and no help, and the README says controllers are unavailable
The root README says no plugins are published while the marketplace publishes specflow
Codex reports isolation as supported though its adapter implements no isolation
Plugin versions reach clients with no tag, no released changelog section and no bump
A crafted specflow state file crashes specflow with a traceback, and reconcile dry-run promises a write the real run cannot make
The validator crashes on a non-UTF-8 plugin.json or SKILL.md and hides other plugins' errors
The validator accepts a plugin root that is a symlink to a directory outside the repo
specflow reads spec artifacts through symlinks that point outside the repository
Duplicate name keys in SKILL.md frontmatter pass validation with the last value winning
--diagnose crashes with an ImportError traceback on macOS stock Python 3.9
--diagnose accepts a project root that does not exist and still reports success
--stage-review error blames the tree ref when the tree text content is what mismatches
Controller retryable flag tells callers to retry where retry cannot succeed and not to retry where identical replay recovers
A controller rejection after the lock file is lost reports revision 0 although the store is at a higher revision
CI cannot run the helper provenance check: a shallow checkout fails it and the pinned-source test always skips
Codex counts as authenticated when ~/.codex/auth.json is a directory
An autopilot CHANGELOG bullet announces prerequisite diagnostics the plugin does not ship
The documented local checks cover only part of what CI runs, so contributors pass locally and fail CI
The validator lets a literal bearer token through in mcp.json headers
